descriptions.w3d_d29e_find_by_guid_and_name_801af938: Searches the 24-byte-ish entries at +20 for one matching a 16-byte id and a name held in a temporary String; on a hit stores the entry's object through out, adds a reference and returns 0, otherwise stores null and returns 0x80004005. As in the original the search loop has no advance: a non-matching first entry never ends. Names are inferred.
